title: Interior Water Loss Review
description: Canonical form for interior water loss file reviews.

canonical.title: Interior Water Loss Review
canonical.description: Interior water loss review focused on cause-of-loss documentation, mitigation evidence, and estimate scope support.

questions.text: Does the file identify the reported source and cause of interior water damage?
questions.comments: Canonical template question has no sub-questions; completed audits must put question-level reasoning here.
questions.help_text: Review loss notes, inspection summaries, plumbing reports, and cause-of-loss documentation.

questions.text: Were affected rooms and materials documented well enough to support the estimate?

sub_questions.text: Room-level photos or notes do not support one or more estimated repair areas.
sub_questions.reasoning: Canonical template marks this driver as applicable for validation.
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the room, photo set, note, or estimate line item that is unsupported.

sub_questions.text: Material quantities or dimensions appear inconsistent with the file evidence.
sub_questions.help_text: Compare estimate quantities against inspection measurements and photos.

questions.help_text: Check photos, diagrams, measurements, and line-item notes for each affected room.

questions.text: Were mitigation or dry-out details considered in the repair recommendation?
questions.comments: Canonical template question has no sub-questions; completed audits must put question-level reasoning here.
questions.help_text: Review mitigation invoices, drying logs, and material removal notes.

canonical.outcome_justification: The canonical template includes a documentation-support opportunity for room-level repair scope.
